summary: High-level product invariants that should survive upstream integrations and refactors.
constraints: Preserve downstream user-facing behavior semantically when taking upstream architecture or bug fixes.
Navigation, app-lock/security behavior, notifications, widgets and AniWorld-specific release semantics are protected regression surfaces.
Do not infer German AniWorld availability from AniList airing data.
When an external match is ambiguous, prefer no match or no navigation over a guessed match.
Do not reintroduce a Wear module unless the user explicitly changes scope.
